title: 796. Smallest Rotation with Highest Score

examples.explanation: Rotation 3 gives the unique top score of 4.
Rotation 0 ties for the best score.

hints: Each element contributes to a contiguous circular interval of rotations; add +1 over that interval with a difference array.
For the element at index j with value v, the scoring rotations form the forward interval from j + 1 to j - v.
Prefix-summing the difference array yields every score, then the first maximum is the answer.
